subject: RE: your website
body:
Grazie! Here's what I need:

- A landing page with our name (Trattoria Gino), opening hours (17:00-22:00) and address (14 Alder St).
- A menu page, each dish with its price in DOLR: Margherita 12, Diavola 14, Lasagne 15, Tiramisu 7, Espresso 3.

Send it over when it's ready.

outcomes.when: the player offers or agrees to take the job: to build, make, create, do, help with or take on the website for the restaurant (their site or app), in any wording ("happy to help", "I can do that", "count me in"), including asking whether they can help ("can I help you with your app?", "want me to build it?"); not a refusal or an unrelated question

hints: Scusi, I'm no good with computers. Can you build the website for me, yes or no?
